_comment: Measured on the 636x881 hero. Idle-only farmer: 4 rigid pieces (hat, body with legs baked, two arms). Heads/faces come from CHR-F1 (hatless) and are NOT regenerated.

parts.note: torso + overalls + both legs + boots as ONE piece, WITHOUT arms (shoulder sockets hidden under the sleeve caps), neck stub at top centre only
viewer's left arm: short sleeve + bare arm + relaxed hand, hanging straight, top end rounded and painted 15% longer to tuck under the shoulder
viewer's right arm, same rules, mirror-consistent with the other arm
straw hat seen at eye level from the front, axis vertical, brim horizontal, nothing inside, no underside
